assumptions: All nodes and capacities are hypothetical demonstration values, not Alibaba hardware inventory.
Role compatibility is an explicit simulation assumption based on matching configured role labels; it is not a verified Alibaba placement rule.
Timestamp-derived simulation times remain in unverified source units and are not seconds.
Application density caps are not enforced unless density_limit_semantics_verified is explicitly set true; the trace field semantics have not been verified.
Negative max_instance_per_node values are rejected by the input adapter unless a specific integer is explicitly configured as a sentinel; they are never silently treated as unlimited.
Resource requests are allocation requirements, not measured consumption or utilization.
